svg.title: The orion workflow
svg.desc: Define: stakeholders and brief, wayfinder, PRD, prd-to-tickets into GitHub Issues. Build: dev-next claims, asks, develops, reviews, merges and audits each story. Learn: harvest-qa, harvest and reconcile-issue-map turn what runs left behind into new issues. Always on: housekeeping and sharing skills.
svg.text: · one story end to end, with no human once it is agent-ready

g.aria-label: Stakeholders & brief: Meet the people who want it. Agree the problem, the users, what success looks like.

text.tspan: Meet the people who want it. Agree

g.aria-label: /wayfinder: Turns a big, foggy idea into a map of decision tickets, then settles them one per session.

text.tspan: Turns a big, foggy idea into a map

g.aria-label: The PRD: The product requirements document: the north star every later step reads.

text.tspan: document: the north star every later

g.aria-label: /prd-to-tickets: Cuts the PRD into epics and stories built so several agents can work side by side.

text.tspan: Cuts the PRD into epics and stories
built so several agents can work

g.aria-label: /dev-quick: A change you want now, with no ticket: files the issue and ships it.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: GitHub Issues: Epics, stories, blockers and labels: the only place work is tracked.
g.text: epics · stories · blockers · labels: the only place work is tracked

g.aria-label: Claim: Checks tools and labels, picks the next free story and claims it.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: Q&A: Removes every guess before code is written.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: Develop: A dev agent builds it in its own worktree, tests first.
Review: A brand-new agent reviews: never the one that wrote it.
Merge: Squash-merges once CI is green, then cleans up after itself.
Audit: Leaves a run report and a QA record, then counts what is due.
audit/<login> branches: Every developer's run reports and QA records, kept off main.
g.text: run reports (deferred · friction · tips) + QA records, one branch per developer, never merged

g.aria-label: /harvest-qa: Drives every finished story's checks against main and files real bugs.

text.tspan: Drives every finished story's checks against main and

g.aria-label: /harvest: Goes through the notes every run left behind, with you, one group at a time.

text.tspan: Goes through the notes every run left behind, with you,

g.aria-label: /reconcile-issue-map: Checks that the PRDs, the issues and the code on main still tell one story.

text.tspan: Checks that the PRDs, the issues and the code on main

g.aria-label: Session-start hook: Pulls, checks for updates and nudges, silently when all is well.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: /orion: Shows what is installed, checks for a newer orion, updates or uninstalls.
/orion-verify: Checks that your rules, orion's rules, the skills and the settings fit together.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: /clear-git-resources: Sweeps stale branches, worktrees and leftover files.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: /issue-map: Draws every issue's blocked-by chain, level by level.
/handoff: Packs this conversation into a handoff for the next session or agent.

g.title: Asks only when something is unclear

g.aria-label: /project-handover: A self-contained HTML handover for clients and new joiners.
/generate-project-writeup: A Word summary of the work delivered, for leadership.

svg.text: bug issues · new tasks · fixed links
